sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: $1\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge moving with velocity $\vec v=\left(\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\right)\mathrm{m/s}$ in the region of magnetic field $\vec B=\left(2\hat i+3\hat j-5\hat k\right)\mathrm{T}$. The magnitude of force acting on it is $\sqrt\alpha\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{N}$. The value of $\alpha$ is ______.
stem.hi: $1\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ आवेश वेग $\vec v=\left(\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\right)\mathrm{m/s}$ से चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\vec B=\left(2\hat i+3\hat j-5\hat k\right)\mathrm{T}$ वाले क्षेत्र में गतिमान है। इस पर लगने वाले बल का परिमाण $\sqrt\alpha\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{N}$ है। $\alpha$ का मान ______ है।

feynman.en: The magnetic force is $q\,\vec v\times\vec B$; work out the cross product and its length.
feynman.hi: चुंबकीय बल $q\,\vec v\times\vec B$ है; सदिश गुणनफल और उसकी लंबाई निकालिए।

steps.en: $\vec v\times\vec B=(10-9)\hat i+(6+5)\hat j+(3+4)\hat k=\hat i+11\hat j+7\hat k$.
steps.hi: $\vec v\times\vec B=(10-9)\hat i+(6+5)\hat j+(3+4)\hat k=\hat i+11\hat j+7\hat k$।
